name: identity_nova_flare
label: Identity Nova
poeticVision: Feel the terrifying power of tearing a piece of your very soul away, weaponizing your core self against encroaching oblivion. Each pulse is a self-inflicted wound, a desperate gasp of 'I am' before the void closes in, leaving you hollowed but momentarily free. The visual decay of your own form reflects the immense cost, deepening the grief of self-loss.

parameters.name: nova_damage
parameters.description: Damage dealt to enemies within the nova's radius.

parameters.name: nova_radius
parameters.description: The radius of the Area3D for detecting and damaging enemies.

parameters.name: identity_cost
parameters.description: The amount of identity (0.0 to 1.0) consumed each time the nova is activated.

parameters.name: nova_burst_duration
parameters.description: The duration of the visual burst animation on Lyra's model.

parameters.name: nova_area_active_duration
parameters.description: How long the Area3D remains active to detect and damage enemies.

parameters.name: min_identity_to_use
parameters.description: The minimum identity level required to activate the nova. If below this, 'identity_depleted' signal is emitted.

parameters.name: degradation_multiplier
parameters.description: A multiplier for how strongly identity loss affects the visual degradation on Lyra's model (shader's 'identity_degradation_level').

parameters.name: character_mesh_path
parameters.description: NodePath to Lyra's MeshInstance3D node, which should have the 'identity_nova_shader.gdshader' applied.

parameters.name: particles_node_path
parameters.description: NodePath to the GPUParticles3D node that will emit particles during the nova burst.

parameters.name: area_node_path
parameters.description: NodePath to the Area3D node used for detecting and damaging enemies.

verdict: A brilliant invention that weaponizes the very essence of self-loss, forging desperate power from the fragments of a fading soul.
impact: This mechanic transforms identity from an abstract narrative concept into a tangible, high-stakes resource, forcing players into agonizing choices between self-preservation and self-destruction. The visual degradation and self-inflicted cost deepen the game's core themes of loss and survival, making every activation a desperate, memorable gamble.
